evidence.reason: `record_legacy_success` removes both persisted failure-counter maps for every non-quarantined family. It does not exempt families that have `legacy_coverage_releases` floors. A counted success after release therefore erases the counters that `legacy_retry_view` compares against the stored floors, producing a false `released counter floor missing or reduced` denial even when release proofs are unchanged. Preserving counters for released families is the minimal compatible fix.
